Ara · RTX 4070 SUPER · 23 October 2026

Photogrammetry, streamed textures and native HDR

Static imports now cook cluster DAGs automatically. Meshes and terrain share GPU-feedback virtual texture pages; typed viewport settings expose the requested diagnostics. HDR10 and scRGB have explicit swapchain paths. Fidelity and editor implementation remain with their owners.

4.56–5.03 ms native · 3.12 ms upscaled

1.088 billion instanced source triangles, geometry + streamed albedo + cached VSM. Native misses the 4 ms target by at least 0.56 ms. This is a standalone rendering slice with simple preview lighting; it does not establish UE5 visual parity.

The scanned relief and texture are present in Ara, but patch repetition, flat ground, uniform roughness and the plain background are conspicuous. Epic’s shot has stronger large-scale composition, layered cliffs, varied materials, atmosphere and indirect lighting. These are different scenes; matching their nominal source-triangle count would not make them equivalent workloads. No UE5 run was measured on this GPU.

What was measured

The actual glTF has 679,936 scan triangles. Two original ground triangles are added per patch; 1,600 static instances produce 1,087,900,800 source triangles. Deterministic translation, yaw and uniform scale vary the patches. The 8k albedo is sampled through a 64 MiB physical pool; full geometry pages fit in memory. The mesh-shader and compute raster paths both execute.

Windows 11, RTX 4070 SUPER, Vulkan timestamps. Each run records 96 frames: 64 settling frames and 32 warm samples. The workstation is shared with other agents; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, no exclusive-GPU claim. The final two native frame medians were 5.028 and 4.559 ms; both raw runs are retained. Upscaled is 1707 × 960 reconstructed to 2560 × 1440 with linear-light bilinear filtering. These timings exclude file/cook/upload preparation, capture readbacks, PNG I/O, the HDR presentation pass, and fidelity lighting.

Warm results use a frozen camera and static casters, with 2,115 native VSM cache hits, zero dirty/missing pages and zero queue overflow. Projection movement currently invalidates the whole shadow cache.

Native draws 213,578 clusters: 13,082,857 software-raster triangles and 97,573 hardware-raster triangles (99.26% software by triangle count). That is not a pixel or GPU-time share. The one-pixel error setting drives the DAG cut; the billion-triangle scene does not have a full-resolution image error proof.

The unchanged procedural workload measured 3.347 ms before this round and 3.487 ms after (+4.2%, shared-load samples). For the new scene, coalescing texture requests and counters within GPU subgroups reduced its initial material resolve from 7.77 ms to 0.91 ms. A tested smaller software-raster threshold was slower and was reverted.

Warm texture residency is 753 / 372 pages of 5,468 virtual pages. The physical allocation has 992 slots. Requested byte totals exclude driver allocation granularity; diagnostic buffers are intentionally included. NVIDIA’s system-wide VRAM reading was 3,216 / 2,933 MiB after allocation, including other applications (roughly 2 GiB before this view). It is not isolated process VRAM.

Scene correspondence requires the same triangle, instance and UV bin (1/256, every eighth pixel). This avoids treating unrelated rocks sharing atlas UVs as a pop. GPU lag counters cover all samples, while temporal matching covers this short trajectory and stable surfaces. It does not prove behavior for every camera speed, LOD replacement, cold start or teleport. The motion test measures texture continuity separately from static VSM timings.

ara-texture-stream uses derivative-driven GPU requests, priorities, LRU leaf eviction, pinned coarse mips and parent-before-child publication. Tiles have 128² interiors and wrapping gutters. Uploads are bounded; decoding and feedback processing stay outside recording. This is software virtual texture paging, not native Vulkan sparse-memory binding. BC7/BC4/BC5 cooked KTX2 inputs are supported; HDR/ASTC source adapters remain work.

Terrain’s deliberately generated streaming fixture increases its color pass from 0.110 to 0.748 ms at 640 × 360 versus its classic procedural material. That cost is recorded rather than hidden. Its 16 MiB pool has 12 resident pages. Scene motion JSON · Planar motion JSON · Terrain before/after JSON.

Import, viewport and HDR seams

glTF and FBX static material primitives now automatically produce ARAG v1 cooked artifacts through ara-importers/ara-asset. Import action versions changed to invalidate old cache entries. MeshSettings.virtualGeometry = false opts out. Manifests link the artifact and diagnostics for slivers/degenerates, broad triangles, material fragmentation, poor occupancy and weak simplification. Skin and morph meshes retain the classic path with a manifest note.

ara-render-geo::settings::{RenderSettings, register_schema} is the typed editor seam for clusters, LOD, overdraw, raster backend, VSM pages and texture mip residency, plus error, budget and display settings. The editor owner still wires the viewport menu and extraction; these renderer snapshots never mutate authoring state.

ara-color::OutputSettings defaults to SDR and exposes paper white (203 nits default) and peak luminance. DisplayOutput consumes exposed linear BT.709 and applies a hue-preserving highlight shoulder, then SDR, BT.2020/PQ HDR10 or scRGB encoding. A creative Neutral/AgX operator can precede it. ara-platform::Present::new_with_output selects a matching advertised swapchain; encoded-mode mismatches fail explicitly.

All three native paths were exercised validation-clean, and GPU output agrees with CPU transfer/color references. Surface support does not establish physical luminance or appearance. The human HDR-display check is pending; HDR.md documents Windows HDR state, meter/observer checks, paper-white changes and SDR comparison. An SDR PNG cannot verify HDR. HDR10 evidence · scRGB evidence. The format and transfer definitions follow Vulkan color spaces.

Fidelity code and its fixed surface/history indices remain untouched. The handoff matches SunShadowSource::VirtualShadowMap { visibility: ImageInput, render_size }: RGB sun visibility, A ≥ 0.5 resident, Graphics/ShaderRead, borrowed until completed render. Invalid pixels fall back to scene tracing; local/secondary rays retain RT. The host must use render_jitter(&FrameInput) and the same camera/render size/jitter. This standalone benchmark remains unjittered.

Verification, comparison and reproduction

Passed tests, all-target clippy with warnings denied, and formatting checks for the nine touched crates: ara-geo, ara-render-geo, ara-vsm, ara-texture-stream, ara-color, ara-gpu, ara-platform, ara-importers and ara-landscape. The explicit million-triangle deterministic cooker test passed. Existing hybrid and landscape goldens remain unchanged; a textured golden was added and repeated.

GPU checks cover mixed-cut edge closure, the existing one-pixel silhouette fixture, hybrid/mesh/indirect visibility, second-pass recovery, page-budget fallback, VSM cache invalidation, spot/cube pages, texture motion, priority/parent residency and native encoding. The shadow fixture compares PCF with one hard full-source RT ray: visibility MAE 0.0511 across 15,218 pixels, not an equivalent soft-shadow reference. Native/upscaled, motion, debug, shadow/reference, terrain and SDR proxy captures were opened and inspected. HDR physical output remains unverified.

Epic publishes approximately 2.5 ms for Nanite culling/rasterization and 2 ms for materials on PS5, at roughly 1400p temporally upscaled to 4K. These are depth/base-pass figures, not the same scene, GPU, presentation path or VSM-inclusive measurement as Ara. They provide context only; no performance or image-quality parity follows. Epic’s published measurement.

The scan is Poly Haven Coast Rocks 01, licensed CC0. ASSET-LICENSES.md records provenance; fetch-scene.ps1 downloads source media on demand and checks publisher hashes. Source media is not committed. The Epic comparison image is copyrighted Epic Games reference media, not a benchmark asset.

crates/ara-render-geo/run.ps1 -Mode Check runs the local gates. -Mode Cook refreshes geometry/texture pipelines; terrain has its own cook example. -Mode Native and -Mode Upscaled run the fetched scan scene; add --motion to the photogrammetry example for continuity captures.
